summary.text: Cesar Aleman is the Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 11 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, he is a minister who attended Gateway Seminary.

paragraphs.text: Cesar Aleman attended Gateway Seminary, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a minister, and he has been affiliated with the Boys & Girls Club.
